jobs.title: Junior Data Entry Clerk
jobs.description:
Position Title:
Junior Data Entry Clerk Location:
Winnipeg, Manitoba Employment Status:
Full-Time Reports To:
Office Manager Overtime Status:
Overtime eligible in accordance with Manitoba Employment Standards

About AIMA

Accurate Indigenous Managers & Advisors (AIMA) partners with First Nations, Indigenous organizations, and businesses to deliver professional consulting, operational support, financial administration, human resources, and organizational development services.

Our team is committed to building strong relationships, supporting Indigenous communities, and helping organizations operate efficiently through practical, people-focused solutions. We believe in collaboration, continuous learning, accountability, and making meaningful contributions to the communities we serve.

Position Summary

The Junior Data Entry Clerk supports Accurate Indigenous Managers & Advisors (AIMA) by ensuring organizational information is entered, maintained, and managed accurately across multiple business systems. This position assists with administrative processes by organizing records, updating databases and financial systems, digitizing documentation, and supporting data integrity across Human Resources, Finance, Operations, and consulting projects.

Working closely with multiple departments, the Junior Data Entry Clerk plays an important role in ensuring organizational information remains accurate, accessible, and secure. This position requires a dependable and accountable individual who can work independently, maintain a high degree of accuracy, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Data Entry & Database Maintenance
Enter, update, and maintain information within organizational databases and software systems.
Enter and maintain applicable information within QuickBooks and Sage 300 as assigned.
Verify the accuracy and completeness of information before entry.
Review records for inconsistencies, missing information, or duplicate entries.
Correct data errors in accordance with established procedures.
Maintain confidentiality while handling sensitive organizational information.
Complete assigned data entry accurately and within established timelines.
Document Management
Scan, upload, and organize digital records.
Maintain electronic and physical filing systems.
Archive historical documentation in accordance with organizational procedures.
Ensure documents are properly labelled, indexed, and stored for easy retrieval.
Assist with records retention and document organization projects.
Administrative Support
Prepare spreadsheets, reports, and tracking documents.
Assist with the creation and maintenance of templates and forms.
Support administrative projects across multiple departments.
Respond to internal requests for documentation and records.
Assist with meeting preparation, document distribution, and filing.
Independently manage assigned administrative and data-entry responsibilities within established deadlines.
Information Quality & Reporting
Perform routine quality checks on databases, financial systems, and spreadsheets.
Identify incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated information.
Generate routine reports and summaries as requested.
Support leadership by providing organized and accurate information.
Recommend opportunities to improve record-keeping processes.
Promptly identify and escalate discrepancies or data-quality concerns that cannot be independently resolved.
Cross-Department Support
Assist Human Resources with employee documentation and personnel records.
Support Finance with document organization, financial filing, and data entry.
Assist Operations with project tracking and administrative documentation.
Support consulting projects through accurate data collection and organization.
Collaborate with staff across departments to maintain accurate organizational records.

Authority & Decision-Making

The Junior Data Entry Clerk is responsible for maintaining the accuracy, confidentiality, and integrity of organizational records while following established procedures.

The position is expected to manage assigned responsibilities independently, take accountability for the accuracy and timely completion of work, identify discrepancies or missing information, and escalate matters requiring supervisory direction.

Qualifications

Required

Minimum 2 years of relevant data entry, administrative, financial administration, or related office experience.
High school diploma or equivalent.
Demonstrated experience using QuickBooks is required.
Demonstrated experience using Sage 300 is required.
Minimum keyboarding speed of 50 words per minute (WPM) with a high degree of accuracy.
Strong computer proficiency.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
Excellent keyboarding and data-entry accuracy.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple competing priorities.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Demonstrated dependability, accountability, and consistent follow-through.
Ability to recognize errors and discrepancies and take appropriate corrective action or escalate concerns.
Ability to manage confidential information professionally.

Assets

Certificate or diploma in Office Administration, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.
Experience using Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or database management systems.
Experience working with Indigenous organizations, consulting firms, or non-profit environments.

Core Competencies

Accuracy
Attention to Detail
Organization
Confidentiality
Time Management
Dependability
Accountability
Independent Work
Initiative
Adaptability
Professional Communication
Ability to Work Under Pressure
Teamwork
Continuous Learning

Working Conditions

Primarily office-based at AIMA's Winnipeg office.
Standard business hours with occasional flexibility based on operational needs.
Extensive computer and keyboard use.
Frequent interaction with multiple departments.
Fast-paced environment requiring the management of multiple priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy.
Regular independent work requiring personal accountability and effective time management.

Why Join AIMA?

At AIMA, you'll become part of a collaborative team committed to supporting Indigenous communities through professional consulting and organizational services. Every role contributes to building stronger organizations, improving systems, and delivering meaningful results.

As a Junior Data Entry Clerk, you'll gain experience working across multiple departments and business systems while developing strong administrative, organizational, and information-management skills.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Accurate Indigenous Managers & Advisors is committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and encourage applications from First Nations, Métis, Inuit, and other Indigenous peoples, as well as members of equity-deserving groups.

Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process upon request.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Business Consulting and Services
